why: Found by I111 before any build commit or measured run (Q67: a test is never dropped from its CI job; amended to name the mode it was written for). R3 says the protocols before I110 name no sort_budget and no compose key, so I110's opt-ins reach no earlier key's record. It globbed every spec/M[4-6]/lib/i*_run.json except i110_run.json, so it also judged later keys: I111's protocol (spec/M6/lib/i111_run.json, I110's plus the types fallback) carries I110's compose and sort_budget keys by construction and would fail it, although no earlier protocol changed. The amended check skips the protocols of I110 and later keys (an iteration number of 110 or more, read from the protocol's own iteration field). The protocols it was written for, and the assertion, are unchanged.
